title: mSecure Warns Users to Change Passwords, Reset 2FA and Passkeys After Suspicious Activity
summary_en: Customers of the mSecure password manager are being urged to act now to protect the confidential information they store in it, possibly by changing passwords, resetting two-factor authentication (2FA), and removing passkeys.
